name: io.github.prismcrawl/prismcrawl
description: Search API for Google, Bing, Amazon, Maps, DuckDuckGo, Yelp, and TripAdvisor, exposed as MCP tools.

headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: PrismCrawl API key. Optional if connecting via OAuth (the server advertises OAuth 2.1 discovery metadata); required only for clients that authenticate with a static API key instead.
